description: This file defines the SecretsController class, which provides API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, decrypting, and deleting secret entities in a web application. It interacts with a database context and handles encryption/decryption of secret data.

classes.name: SecretsController
classes.description: API controller for managing secrets, including creation, retrieval, update, decryption, and deletion operations.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Creates a new secret, encrypts its value, and stores it in the database.

methods.name: GetSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret by its ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a list of secrets with optional limit.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Decrypts and retrieves the value of a secret by its ID.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Updates an existing secret, re-encrypts its value.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a secret by its ID, with audit logging.
